definition: to be very interested in something
description: At a bright record fair in a hall with tall windows, a young woman with long dark curls, in an olive jacket, beige knit top and jeans, kneels by wooden crates full of vinyl records with a thick stack under one arm. She eagerly lifts a record with an orange label in a crate, then lets go of it and hugs her stack of records to her chest. A chalkboard price sign stands on the crates. Behind her people browse the stalls: a man with headphones, a stallholder with a box and a young man lowering his raised arm.

to rummage in a cardboard box
